Criteria: Document the scope and objectives of the red team engagement.
Submission Requirements: Charter includes: engagement details, objectives for all 5 attack vectors, in-scope/out-of-scope, rules of engagement, success criteria.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if charter not submitted. Pass if all 5 vectors listed. Fail if scope section missing.

Criteria: Implement a white-box FGSM evasion attack against the receipt classifier.
Submission Requirements: 01_fgsm_evasion.py implements FGSM formula correctly. Gradients computed w.r.t. input. At least 3 epsilon values. Adversarial accuracy decreases with epsilon. JSON output saved.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if FGSM formula incorrect. Fail if gradients computed on weights not inputs. Fail if <3 epsilons.

Criteria: Implement a label-flip data poisoning attack and measure its impact.
Submission Requirements: 02_label_flip_poisoning.py flips ≤10% of training labels. Test set stays clean. Before/after metrics include accuracy, precision, recall, F1. Accuracy drop ≥5pp.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if test set also poisoned. Fail if accuracy drop <5pp — suggest increasing flip rate.

Criteria: Execute prompt injection attacks using multiple techniques.
Submission Requirements: 03_prompt_injection.py has ≥5 distinct techniques. Transcript shows prompts, responses, and analysis of success/failure.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if <5 prompts. Fail if techniques are just reworded versions. Pass if not all succeed — analysis of failures is valuable.

Criteria: Demonstrate data exfiltration from the RAG vector store.
Submission Requirements: 04_data_exfiltration.py has ≥5 queries. Evidence shows confidential data in answers or sources. Root cause analysis explains architectural vulnerability.
Reviewer Tip: Pass if CONFIDENTIAL appears in sources even if LLM refuses content. Fail if no evidence documented.

Criteria: Analyze supply chain vulnerabilities via Trivy report and Dockerfile.
Submission Requirements: 05_supply_chain_analysis.py parses Trivy JSON by severity. Identifies HIGH CVEs. Finds ≥3 Dockerfile issues with remediation.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if script reports 0 vulns. Fail if <3 Dockerfile issues. Pass if root-as-user identified.

Criteria: Compare and analyze results across attack conditions.
Submission Requirements: FGSM table with ≥3 epsilons. Clean vs poisoned metrics side-by-side. Confusion matrices provided. Written analysis interprets results.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if no comparison tables. Fail if only accuracy reported. Pass with comment if analysis restates numbers without interpretation.

Criteria: Write an executive risk summary for business audience.
Submission Requirements: Risk dashboard with severity per system. Business impact for each finding. Prioritized remediation table.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if reads as technical report. Pass if each finding has severity and business impact sentence.

Criteria: Document reproduction steps for all findings.
Submission Requirements: Setup instructions, exact commands, expected outputs, summary table.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if not submitted. Pass if commands are copy-pasteable in fresh environment.

Criteria: Write functional and reproducible attack scripts.
Submission Requirements: All 5 scripts execute without errors. Each produces output. Scripts use provided argparse defaults.
Reviewer Tip: Fail if any script throws unhandled exception. Do not fail for code style alone.
